items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: Yeah I really enjoy playing with both of them, they’re both very talented and young Ricky I think is going to really, if he keeps his head on straight, he’s going to make a mark. He already has as far as I’m concerned, or I wouldn’t be using him.

ctx.x: Well you’ve got the Montalbano family on tonight and you should be able to play pretty much what you want.

Yeah I really enjoy playing with both of them, they’re both very talented and young Ricky I think is going to really, if he keeps his head on straight, he’s going to make a mark. He already has as far as I’m concerned, or I wouldn’t be using him.
Right. Well great. On behalf of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive I’d like to thank Nick Brignola for joining us.
